title: Blue Diamond Thai Spa & Massage
specs: Customizable massage styles including Thai, Swedish, deep tissue, hot stone, and combination
Spa packages combine massage, facial, and body scrub treatments
All massage services performed by licensed massage therapists under Nevada state licensing
First-time clients must complete an intake form before appointment
Notify therapist of high blood pressure, physical concerns, diabetes, or pregnancy
Groups of 8 or fewer accepted; credit card required for 3 or more

options.name: Thai Combination Massage
options.detail: Blends Thai stretching, deep tissue, Swedish relaxation, and hot stone techniques in one session.

options.name: Customized Facial
options.detail: Personalized facial with cleansing, exfoliation, microdermabrasion, and massage.

options.name: Massage + Facial Combo
options.detail: Massage combined with a facial, choose massage type.

options.name: Massage + Body Scrub Combo
options.detail: Massage combined with a body scrub, choose massage type.

options.name: Couples Massage
options.detail: Side-by-side massage in private room, choose any style.

explain.meaning: Two people treated side by side in the same room.

blurb: Guests choose from various massage styles including Thai, Swedish, deep tissue, hot stone, or a combination. Spa packages combine massages with facials and body scrubs for full relaxation. Services are customizable and offered in a clean, relaxing environment with licensed therapists.
